name: Мимо тëщиного дома
overview: Elena Danilevskaya is a lawyer at a large consulting firm specializing in corporate bankruptcies. For a year now, she has not communicated with her only daughter Katya, a graduate of MGIMO, or with her son-in-law Valera, a former military man. After his retirement due to injury, together with Katya and his son Deniska, he leaves Moscow to rebuild his native village of Chernogorka. But when Elena learns from her grandson that Katya is expecting her second child and is in the hospital, she urgently goes to the village with the firm intention of ending her son-in-law's missionary feat. Either Valera and her family will return to Moscow voluntarily, or Lena will take her daughter and grandson to civilization by force. But as soon as Lena sets foot on Montenegrin soil, it turns out that she underestimated her son-in-law's tenacity.
